author: Maya Ortiz
text: Fourth floor of Hunt is silent and somehow still has three open window seats. Get here before noon.

author: Jordan Lee
text: Howling Cow has pumpkin spice today. You know what to do.

author: Sam Patel
text: Someone brought a golden retriever to the Brickyard and there is now a line to pet it.

author: Ava Brooks
text: The tunnel got repainted overnight. Whoever did the giant wolf with sunglasses: respect.

author: Chris Nguyen
text: Pickup basketball at 5. Need two more.

author: Lena Fischer
text: Group study rooms on the second floor are all booked until 8. The Makerspace is open though.

author: Marcus Hill
text: Route 3 is running about 10 minutes late. Plan accordingly.

author: Priya Raman
text: Lake Raleigh at sunset after a long studio day. Worth the walk.

author: Tyler Grant
text: Tailgate lot is already filling up for Saturday. Red and white, everybody.

author: Nora Kim
text: Free coffee from the design club booth until it runs out.

author: Diego Alvarez
text: Lost a navy NC State hoodie in the Talley food court around lunch. If you find it, it has a coffee stain on the left sleeve and it's my favorite one, please. I've had it since freshman orientation and it has been through two moves, one flood, a whole semester of 8am classes in Harrelson and more late nights at Hunt than I want to admit. It's not much to look at anymore but it's mine. I'll trade a large Howling Cow cone for its safe return, no questions asked.

author: Grace Owens
text: The robot book retrieval thing is running and it never gets old.

author: Ben Carter
text: The Belltower is lit red tonight. Big win.

author: Ivy Thompson
text: Anyone else's 8am just get cancelled or is it only mine?

author: Omar Haddad
text: Volleyball game tonight, free entry with your student ID.
